faq._review: Draft translation — needs review by lawyer (billing wording) and partner physio (safety wording) before launch
faq.q1: How do I get back to sport without risking a relapse?
faq.a1: Your programme moves forward in stages set by your physio: you only move on to the next one once the previous one is mastered. If you report pain, your physio sees it and can adapt the programme.
faq.q2: Can I do my exercises on my own, safely?
faq.a2: Each exercise is shown on video or as an animated drawing, with written instructions. During the session, a reminder tells you to stop if you feel sharp pain. At the end, you rate your pain, and your physio sees it.
faq.q3: How can my physio follow me remotely?
faq.a3: They see your adherence, completed sessions and feedback on pain or difficulty over time, and adjust your programme between two appointments at the practice.
faq.q4: Do I need equipment or a camera at home?
faq.a4: No, a phone is enough: you follow the exercises on screen, with the drawing and instructions in front of you. No camera or smartwatch. If an exercise needs an object (resistance band, chair), your physio knows from what you declared.
faq.q5: What happens to my health data?
faq.a5: It is used only for your follow-up: your sessions and how you felt are visible to you and your practitioner, never sold or used for advertising.
faq.q6: How much does the app cost me as a patient?
faq.a6: After {trialDays} free days, you choose a monthly offer: {offers}. Each total combines access to the app (€{low} to €{high} depending on the commitment), paid monthly to EasyPhysio, and €{kine} for your physio’s programme, paid directly to them, only in months when they update your programme. You receive two separate invoices, and you can cancel at any time from the app. Not reimbursed by the French national health insurance (Assurance Maladie).
faq.q7: I'm a practitioner: how can I try it with my patients?
faq.a7Open: Create your practitioner account, build a first programme from the exercise library, connect your Stripe account to be paid directly by your patients, then invite them. They'll get access without installing anything other than the app on their phone.
faq.a7Waitlist: EasyPhysio is in testing: join the waiting list at the bottom of this page and we'll write to you when we open. Then create your practitioner account, build a first programme from the exercise library, connect your Stripe account to be paid directly by your patients, then invite them. They'll get access without installing anything other than the app on their phone.
